item.title: DoW Programs Fund Bachelors, Masters, and PhD Students: Virtual Info Session Scheduled for Sept. 23, 1pm
item.description: The DoW SMART Scholars and National Defense Science and Engineering Graduate programs fund up to five years for Bachelors, Masters, or PhD students in STEM fields. Citizens of the U.S., UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand are eligible to apply. Register HERE: https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE for the virtual information session on Sept 23rd at 1pm, or email madige@rpi.edu for more information.

item.description: The RPI Counseling Center invites students to meet with a counselor without a formal appointment, during designated drop-in hours. There are drop-in hours available every weekday when classes are in session. Academy Hall Suite 4200.

item.title: Black Hawk Helicopter Landing on 86 Field-National Manufacturing Day
item.description: Date: Friday, September 25, 2026 8:45 AM - 2:45 PM - As part of the School of Engineering’s program for National Manufacturing Day, a Black Hawk helicopter landing (weather permitting) will take place on 86 Field at approximately 8:45 a.m. The helicopter will remain on campus for tours and photos and depart campus at 3:00 p.m.

item.title: September 23rd Cognitive Science Seminar with Dr. Sanjay Oruganti
item.description: Please join the Cognitive Science Department on Wednesday, September 23rd, for a presentation by Dr. Sanjay Oruganti, Research Scientist in the Language, Embodiment, Intelligence, Agency (LEIA) Lab in the Cognitive Science Department at RPI. The presentation is titled “Why Cognitive Robotics Matters: Lessons from OntoAgent and LLM Deployment in HARMONIC for Safety-Critical Robot Teaming.”

item.title: Work in Progress: WAKE
item.description: Thursday / September 24, 2026 at 7:00 pm This work-in-progress of WAKE is a performance ritual for grief combining the languages of queer nightlife, Catholicism, combat, and kapwa—a Filipino concept of shared identity and interconnectedness. Jay Carlon’s choreography and Micaela Tobin’s live vocals and electronics invite a celebration of each other and our ancestors, past and future. Performance, Work in Progress Jay Carlon

item.title: Work in Progress: WAKE
item.description: Date: Thursday, September 24, 2026 7:00 PM - 8:30 PM - How do we find joy in the aftermath of loss? Join us at EMPAC for a free work-in-progress excerpt of WAKE. Choreographer Jay Carlon and composer Micaela Tobin (vocals, electronics) are reimagining an immersive performance ritual for grief that brings together the dance floor and boxing ring with the Filipino concept of kapwa. item.title: Rob Carney Retirement Announcement and Reception
item.description: Rob Carney, Director of Campus Planning & Facilities Design, will retire on September 30, 2026, following 38 years of dedicated service to RPI. His leadership and contributions have left a lasting impact across the Institute. Please join us on Tuesday, September 29, anytime between 2:00 and 4:00 p.m. at the Heffner Alumni House, Great Room, to congratulate Rob, thank him for his many years of service, and wish him well in retirement.

item.description:

The institute has standard defined questions for the SoE midterm, but if you wanted to add a few questions on top of what is already defined this training is for you.
